description.narrative: The development objective of the Energy Efficiency Project for Bosnia and Herzegovina is to demonstrate the benefits of energy efficiency improvements in public sector buildings and support the development of scalable energy efficiency financing models. The project has three components. The first component energy efficiency investments in public facilities will support energy efficiency investments ('subprojects') in schools, hospitals, and clinic centers. This component will finance energy efficiency upgrades, as well as related technical consultancy services (for example, energy audits, technical and social monitoring and evaluation, technical designs, supervision, and subproject commissioning). The second component, support for the development of scalable financing mechanisms and capacity building will support the development of sustainable energy efficiency financing mechanisms in the public sector, strengthen implementation capacity, and help to increase public awareness on energy efficiency. The third component project management will ensure effective project management by the project implementing units (PIUs) through financing additional experts, trainings for PIU staff, and covering incremental operating costs.
The project development objective is to improve energy efficiency in public buildings, and to support the development and implementation of scalable energy efficiency financing models

title.narrative: Increase in end-user satisfaction in RS

comment.narrative: The end-user satisfaction was done through social surveys among direct project beneficiaries before and after the completion efficiency investments in selected public buildings, and showed higher satisfaction than its target.

The total number of buildings retrofitted under BEEP and AF is 156. The slightly lower number of buildings compared to the target is attributed to a higher portion of large complex buildings, including hospitals and large government offices.

title.narrative: Reflows from EE repayments and captured energy cost savings

comment.narrative: Overachieved by 13 percent. *The original target of 80,000 was set far too low focusing solely on direct workers of the facilities. Healthcare facilities in particular have the capacity to attract a significant number of users on a daily basis

title.narrative: Development and implementation of customized skills training for target female beneficiaries.

target.value: Customized skills training to target female groups developed and implemented with at least 75% of trained female being satisfied with skills acquired

comment.narrative: A series of female-targeted skill trainings was conducted, and their satisfaction rates were accessed post-session. In FBiH, over 95% of trained females reported satisfaction with the skills acquired, while in RS, 81% of attendees expressed satisfaction with provided training.

actual.value: Customized EE trainings for female professionals delivered and 88% of the trained women were satisfied with the skills acquired

title.narrative: Development and implementation of scalable EE financing models

target.value: Revolving EE financing models implemented and post-BEEP arrangements defined

comment.narrative: Scalable energy efficiency financing models have been initiated and started its operation. In FBiH, the initial capital has increased to 6 million euros for the FBiH Energy Efficiency Revolving Fund (RF). Construction work on the first two buildings under the RF began in 2023 with one more building set to begin tendering in the coming months. RS also put in place a revolving energy savings collection mechanism to capture the reflows. The budget reflows from energy savings achieved by BEEP AF has been transferred to the Environmental Protection and Energy Efficiency Fund for additional building retrofitting. Furthermore, a pilot for performance-based contracting has been successfully completed.

actual.value: Revolving fund being operational with three public building retrofitting started. (FBIH) Revolving financing models started the reflow capture, transferring fund to the Environmental Protection and Energy Efficiency Fund for additional retrofitting. (RS)
